title: Network command board redesign
summary: Redesigned the backend-served WebView Network Workers tab into a scan-first command board with a compact health strip, role-aware quick actions, diagnostic chips, a primary Worker Board, a structured selected-worker inspector, and collapsed setup/settings/advanced/unavailable drawers.
reason: The previous Network Workers tab repeated saved/runtime information, exposed a long lifecycle button wall, and buried the actionable worker state under verbose evidence text.
behavior_before: The Network Workers tab opened with long status and lifecycle sections, duplicate role/runtime text, separate dry-run and confirmed lifecycle buttons, and a lower preformatted worker detail dump.
behavior_after: The Network Workers tab opens on a compact operational command board. Guided Check & Start / Request Stop controls run existing backend dry-run routes before opening the existing confirmation dialog, diagnostics are summarized as status chips, worker rows are the primary table, and rare evidence/settings/setup controls are collapsed into drawers.
tests_added: Updated tests/webview/test_webview_browser_network_smoke.py coverage for command-board layout, role-aware quick actions, guided dry-run confirmation behavior, drawers, worker inspector, and compact filter warnings.
Updated tests/webview/test_webview_network_read_only_boundary.py static coverage for new panel order, drawer placement, guided lifecycle buttons, and DOM boundary expectations.
